item.title: Turkey burial site transforms understanding of Midas kingdom
item.description: Archaeologists at the Karaagac burial site in northwestern Turkey have uncovered a wooden grave chamber containing ornate bronze artifacts and ceramic treasures that demonstrate the Midas dynasty wielded far greater power and territorial control than historical records indicated, with the burial located 99 miles west of the ancient Phrygian capital Gordion.
